gate.rule: within-commit pairwise accuracy (pairs with different attention labels, a predicted tie half right): above file-position order leaving one repo out overall, below it in at most 2 repos, and above it on gold

tree_count.rule: smallest count within 0.005 of the best pooled leave-one-repo-out log-loss, every 5 up to 1000

selection.rule: the model with the higher leave-one-repo-out within-commit pairwise accuracy, lightgbm on a tie

gate.rule: doubt below the highest P(faithful) threshold whose leave-one-repo-out flags are unfaithful >= 0.5 of the time (>= 5 flags); passes when there it finds >= 0.2 of the unfaithful rationales and on gold >= 0.25 while flagging <= 0.03 of the faithful

tree_count.rule: smallest count within 0.005 of the best pooled leave-one-repo-out AUROC (silver and extra, weighted), every 5 up to 1000

selection.rule: the model with the higher leave-one-repo-out average precision for unfaithful rationales, lightgbm on a tie

gate.rule: the policy raises wrong hides in no repo, leaving one repo out and on gold, and lowers them overall in both

policy.picked_on: leave-one-repo-out on silver, fewest wrong hides + missed skips
policy.rule: noise flag; un-hide at P(skip) < unhide; hide a shown hunk at P(skip) >= 0.9

ranking.note: informational, not the gate: hunch's ranking at the noise flag's hide rate

tree_count.rule: smallest count within 0.005 of the best pooled leave-one-repo-out AUROC, every 5 up to 1000

selection.rule: lightgbm if gold AUROC gain over logistic >= 0.03, or if leaving one repo out logistic makes more wrong hides than the noise flag at its hide rate and lightgbm does not
